test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In June 2022, NIPUN scheme was launched for skill training of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is construction workers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'NIPUN,' a cutting-edge initiative for the skill development of construction workers, **was **introduced by the Minister of Housing & Urban Affairs and Petroleum & Natural Gas Hardeep Singh Puri** (National Initiative for Promoting Upskilling of Nirman workers).
 
• **The project is a brainchild of the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MoHUA) **and falls under the umbrella of its flagship programme, **the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM),** which aims to train over one lakh construction workers through new skill-upgrading and training programmes and offer them employment opportunities abroad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NIPUN scheme**

 
 
• **​The NIPUN project is an effort of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) **under its flagship scheme of **the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)** to train over 1 lakh construction workers through fresh skilling and upskilling programmes and to give them with work possibilities in other nations.
 
• Those present included** Shri Sanjay Kumar, Secretary, of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Shri Sunil Barthwal, Additional Secretary, of the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Shri Manoj Joshi, Secretary, of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, and Shri Rajesh Aggarwal, Secretary, Ministry of Labour and Employment.**
